high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation with a black background and white text. The title of the slide is "8. Agents and causality (important distinction)." Below the title, there are two main points: Reality has causality. Agents discover and exploit it. Following these points, there is an explanation about what it means for an agent to be causal: An agent is causal if: \( p(s_{t+1} \mid s_t, a_t) \neq p(s_{t+1} \mid s_t) \) Action reveals counterfactual structure
